who: any two or three squad members as a fight begins (shield-bearer, archer, mage, healer, duellist, brigand)

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: To arms! They're in the camp!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: My boots! Where are my boots?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Last fight I take for you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then make it a good one.

who: a shield-bearer or spearman giving the order, and any squad member

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Stand fast. Keep close to me.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Gods, I want to chase them.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hold, he says. Easy for him.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Stand still. Let the Vigil settle.

who: a shield-bearer or spearman bodyguarding, and an archer, mage or healer behind them

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Arrows on the mage! Cover her!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Catch the arrows! I've got it!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Body in the lane! Block them!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why am I always the wall?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Keep them off the carts too!

who: an archer or mage kiting, and any squad member

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Loose and walk! Loose and walk!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Run and shoot. Run and shoot.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Fall back down the road, shooting!

who: any two squad members breaking off a fight

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's the one order I like.

who: a duellist or brigand circling, and a shield-bearer holding the front

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Circling! Keep his eyes on you!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A shield only guards one way!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then I'll take the other way.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You're quick. Shut up and go.

who: a hammer-fighter, spearman or mage knocking an enemy into terrain, and any squad member

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Shields are the wall! Send them!

who: any two squad members minding their weapon's measure (spear, hammer, axe, bow, staff)

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Get in close with that hammer!

who: any two squad members as red ground marks a heavy blow

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It's winding up! Clear the ring!

who: two shield-bearers locking shields, and any squad member behind them

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Close up! Gap on the left!

who: a badly hurt squad member and the one nearest them

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Told you to wear the mail.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Over here, you dogs! Face me!

who: a squad member drinking from a belt slot, and another covering them

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then go be tall at them.

who: any two squad members as one of the squad is knocked down
a squad member carrying a downed ally (B) out, and another covering

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Put me down! I can walk!

who: a Born survivor (A) whose last stand triggers, and any squad member
a mage casting (A) and any squad member near the blast

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Their mage! I'll snap his thread!

who: a healer or cleric (A) healing or warding, and any squad member

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Light burns the Blight! Behind me!

who: any two squad members facing an elite, a named calamity or Drakrevor's horde

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Kill it, and it never returns!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: One on one. My kind of dance.

who: any two squad members fighting Blight horrors

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Horrors! Don't let them touch you!

who: any two squad members fighting outlaws
any two squad members fighting wolves, bears or boar

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Keep the rocks at our backs.

who: any two squad members fighting town guards while the player is hunted

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Don't kill them if we can.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I signed for coin, not this.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Off the road! Into the trees!

who: any two or three squad members once the fight is won

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's the last of them. We're alive.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Alive and sore. I'll take it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Ha! Did you see that? Did anybody see that?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We won. Does winning come with pay?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It won't rise again. They'll sing of this in {town}.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Road's clear. Strip what's worth taking.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Nothing's worth taking. Outlaws are poor.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The gate held! The gate held!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Quiet again. Even the birds are back.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then let's go before more come.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Wipe your blade before it rusts.

who: any two or three squad members running from a lost fight

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Fall back! It's lost! Fall back!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Everyone out! Grab who you can!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I said this was a bad idea!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Say it again when we're alive!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Into the trees! Break their line of sight!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's it. I'm done with this band.

who: any two or three squad members counting the cost after a fight

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This wound will keep me off my feet a week.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then rest. We'll carry the load.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Another fight, another hole in me. Same pay.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Talk to the captain, not me.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Belt's empty. Every last draught gone.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We'll buy more in {town}, if we live.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Get the fire high. Wounded closest.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Bury them here, or carry them home?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That one's still alive. Do we help him?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The captain would. Get the bandages.
